# OT-61 C3c-1: the C-ABI symbols a LogansOS binary links against, one per line:
# neo-crt's, plus Rust's compiler_builtins (memcpy, memmove, the integer and
# float helpers), which every product binary links too. generator/neo-cc links
# configure's test programs against these alone, so a link-based check passes
# only for a function we really have. Taken with llvm-nm (defined, extern) from
# neo-crt as of main efc46cde (2026-11-08) and its compiler_builtins, with Rust
# symbols left out. Regenerate when neo-crt changes; the generator will check it.
